method: Independent read-only inspection of final diff, source, callers, real component tests and owner-produced JSON/log evidence. No reviewer imports, tests, build, browser, API, database, credential reads or process operations.
scope: Authorized RF03/CP3-18 legacy unsupported-currency partial valuation and CP3-06 fractional USD display only. Twelve product sources and six tests are pinned.

resolvedDuringReview.issue: Hero partial message described only accounts although total can include portfolio.
resolvedDuringReview.resolution: Final source says subtotal de los componentes con valoración disponible.

resolvedDuringReview.issue: Bimonetary excluded-account metadata could label stored mixed balance as the primary currency amount.
resolvedDuringReview.resolution: Final aggregate uses multicurrency_balance_primary for credit-card primary metadata and preserves secondary balance separately; returned original account.balance stays unchanged. Significant regression uses stored−10010, primary−10000, secondary−10.

designChecks.evidence: accountsService.list adds optional allowPartialValuation; omitted/false options retain original strict FX path. getTotalBalance/getTotalBalanceWithInvestments, AI get_accounts/get_net_worth and Telegram calls retain strict defaults.

No new catch wraps account query, multicurrency RPC, blue provider or supported currency rates. Only currencies outside the exact existing ACCOUNT_CURRENCIES set are skipped when explicitly opted in. Supported EUR or blue failures and database errors propagate; Auth is still checked by routes before owner-scoped account query.

Excluded rows retain original balance/currency and primary/secondary balances; converted USD/ARS fields are absent, not fabricated0/1. AccountEquivalents and card/list/detail components gate conversion UI on valuationIssue and show explicit reason.

User scope and active-account query remain unchanged. includeInvestments:false remains functional. aggregate checks include_in_total:false before valuation exclusion, so intentionally excluded rows do not make the selected total incomplete. include_in_liquid classification and supported/debt valuation remain unchanged.

An unsupported leg excludes the whole bimonetary account conservatively and explicitly, as approved by parent; both original leg amounts are disclosed. It does not present only the known leg as the full account value or silently treat secondary debt as0.

recordNetWorthSnapshot returnsfalse before obtaining/upserting a snapshot when valuation.partial. Dashboard also suppresses snapshot call and StickyNetWorthBar on partial totals. Hero suppresses complete-vs-partial delta; existing history-only chart series remains unchanged, with no invented today point. History is still readable.

Real Hero exposes explicit subtotal/excluded account names, original currencies/amounts and reason; hidden Hero amounts respect its existing privacy mask. JSX escapes the dynamic strings. Accounts/card/detail prevent fake converted zero rows.

Hero main/secondary/delta and monetary tooltip use2decimals for fractionalUSD and0for integers; Sticky USD uses same selection. ARS formatting and compact chart ticks are unchanged. Unit SSR reaches the actual Hero defaultARS equivalent; it honestly does not claim hydrated USD toggle or Sticky visibility.

limitations: This source/unit/SSR change is not original CP3-18 authenticated API/system PASS or a CI6 global build. Those separately authorized tests remain required.
Original CI5 CP3-18 API500 and CP3-06 SSR182 failures remain immutable historical evidence bound to7c3e872/vPLj. No new source is attributed to that old served app.

Account pages already had catch-to-empty behavior; this patch does not add that catch and does not prove universal failure handling for those pages. API/dashboard/service failure boundaries inspected here are narrower.
SSR main Hero value still starts0 pending its existing client count-up. Static tests use actual secondary value and do not invent a completed animation/visual check.
Supported FX provider availability, production behavior, new currency support and schema changes are outside this review.
